title: Monetary gain
body: In my opinion is this app out for your money. They sent me invoices for a payment of a premium subscription because i did not cancel my test subscription online on their webpage thefabulous.co because i thought it was enough if i did that on the app store alone. After sending them my complaints and issues they just agreed to delete all my information and my accound but they still are trying every day to withdraw money directly from my bank account even though i cancelled the subscription. They deleted my account and i deleted the app. So i now need to pay for a service i never wanted and did not use. I just wanted to warn you about this app. Its not ethical what they are doing especially because its an app for people with adhd. And i think they used that fact to their advantage. However good the app may be. For someone who just looked into the app for 2 days, then cancelled the subscription, still having to pay for a quarter yearly subscription afterwards is not okay. They say you need to cancel the subscription online on their website thefabulous.co because in my case cancelling it on the app store was not enough... beware. Take care people.
author: anamarx99

title: Sound Notifications
body:
There are sound notifications from the app even if notifications are disabled. Took me ages to find where the notifications came from.

Apart from the notifications issue, the app feels like most of it’s content was never double-checked (obvious typos and formatting issues).

The idea gor the app might be good, but the whole thing is half-baked and sloppy. Really disappointing and definitely not worth the money.
author: GherkinTreeRoot

title: not very adhd friendly
body: I was looking for an easy to use task organizer, maybe some tips to manage procrastination. Instead I was flooded with reading material and videos. Even though it might be helpful, I neither have the energy nor discipline to see it through. Sorry. My brain is overloaded already, from an app like this I expect instant gratification, something to motivate me to structure my life without the blah blah.
